title: Promote draft Callaway Chart Editor values to code-based default grid charts

requirements.text: Update the code-based default Callaway grid chart values so they match the edited values currently in the Callaway Chart Editor draft, and use those values as the new shipped defaults.

quotes: copy the edited values from the Callaway Chart Editor in the draft  into the default table  and use those for the new default values

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartPersistence.ts` functions `getDefault18GridChart()` and `getDefault9GridChart()` are updated so their `grid` and `columnAdjustments` values exactly match the edited values from the draft Callaway Chart Editor.
With a fresh browser profile (no existing localStorage keys for Callaway charts), the app loads using the updated default grid chart values for both 9-hole and 18-hole.

After clearing localStorage keys `callaway-grid-chart-18-user-default` and `callaway-grid-chart-9-user-default` (and any active grid keys), using “Reset to Defaults” results in the updated code-based defaults being used/initialized.

requirements.text: Update the default-values documentation to reflect that the shipped defaults now match the draft editor’s edited chart values, and remind how localStorage can mask code default changes.

quotes: copy the edited values from the Callaway Chart Editor in the draft  into the default table  and use those for the new default values

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/docs/callaway-chart-defaults.md` references the updated defaults and clearly states that existing localStorage user-default charts must be cleared to see code-default changes take effect.
All user-facing documentation text is in English.

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI components).
Do not modify immutable hook/bootstrap files: `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`.
Keep changes limited to updating shipped default chart values and related documentation; do not introduce new persistence keys or storage mechanisms.
nonGoals: Do not add new admin features or new UI flows in the Callaway Chart Editor.
Do not change backend Motoko state, schemas, or scoring algorithms beyond using the updated default chart values.
Do not add third-party integrations or authentication changes.
